items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So I was supposed to be a member of Chick's band... I'm still with Chick.

ctx.x: Kirkpatrick, yeah. So I was supposed to be a member of Chick's band, you know. Well, makin' rehearsals every day, we rehearsed... Because we always had good music to rehearse. And Chick would get a kick out of hearing the band rehearse. He liked to hear it rehearse so much he didn't get no work for it! So everybody was working in somebody else's band.
